Pelagytics is currently a **concept and prototype direction**, not a released software product.

## Current status

No canonical public repository has been verified for Pelagytics. For that reason it is not included in the primary scientific-software catalogue and no installation, release, API, or reproducibility claims are made here.

The concept concerns modular integration of fisheries, biological, environmental, and spatial information into reproducible indicators and decision-support products.

## Promotion criteria

Pelagytics should return to the primary Software catalogue only after it has:

- a canonical repository;
- defined software scope and governance;
- documented data boundaries;
- reproducible installation;
- tests;
- license and citation metadata;
- a minimum viable public interface or API.

This page is retained primarily to preserve the established `/software/pelagytics/` URL during the website migration.
